texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]的船员们兴奋地报告称他们在[From.GetName]上发现了一处古代太空文明的遗迹，其似乎于七百万年前定居于这一行星！

尽管这些自称古茹努尔的物种离开[From.GetStarName]星系的原因尚不明确，我们的科学家已经在这颗行星上分离出了一处很有发掘价值的考古遗址。

也许进一步的研究会找到更多线索。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew are eager to report they have uncovered the remains of an ancient space-faring species on [From.GetName], who appear to have inhabited the planet some seven million years ago!

While it is unclear why this species, who called themselves the Grunur, disappeared from the [From.GetStarName] system, our scientists have isolated a promising archaeological dig site on their planet.

Perhaps further study will yield more clues.

texts.zh:
这些遗迹被认为是古代行政建筑群，它们属于一个自称为古茹努尔的太空物种，该物种是在[From.Planet.GetName]上被发现的。

令人震惊的是，这个失落的文明似乎在七百万年前就居住在这颗星球上了，我们的考古学家渴望揭开他们的秘密。
texts.en:
The remains of what is believed to be an ancient administrative complex, belonging to a space-faring species who called themselves the Grunur has been found on [From.Planet.GetName].

This fallen civilization appears to have inhabited the planet a staggering seven million years ago, and our archaeologists are eager to uncover their secrets.

sections.zh:
这些遗迹被认为是古代行政建筑群，它们属于一个自称为古茹努尔的太空物种，该物种是在[From.Planet.GetName]上被发现的。

令人震惊的是，这个失落的文明似乎在七百万年前就居住在这颗星球上了，我们的考古学家渴望揭开他们的秘密。
sections.en:
The remains of what is believed to be an ancient administrative complex, belonging to a space-faring species who called themselves the Grunur has been found on [From.Planet.GetName].

This fallen civilization appears to have inhabited the planet a staggering seven million years ago, and our archaeologists are eager to uncover their secrets.

texts.zh:
在对发掘现场找到的古代数据晶体进行解密后，我们获得了一份古茹努尔战功的编年史。虽然大多只是他们的本地事务，对我们意义不大，其中仍有数卷详细描述了古茹努尔与被称为巴奥有机体的外星物种的第一次接触。

除了巴奥是一种巨型植物类物种，在群星间播种了众多殖民地以外，我们目前对它还所知无几。
texts.en:
Decoded ancient datacrystals have been found at the dig site, chronicling the Grunur's military exploits. While most are local and of little interest, several volumes detail the Grunur's first encounter with an alien species referred to as The Baol Organism.

Little more can be gleaned about the Baol at this point, save that they were a massive, plantoid species, and had many colonies seeded among the stars.

texts.zh:
数据晶体中的记录表明古茹努尔曾对巴奥发动战争，希图夺取其行星据称拥有的丰富资源。我们已经成功从一份该类型的记录中提取出了一组恒星系坐标！

我们的考古学家正在将该行星的位置上传至我们的系统中。
texts.en:
Datacrystal records reveal that the Grunur waged war against the Baol, desiring the plentiful resources purportedly found on their planets. A set of system coordinates has been successfully extracted from one such record!

Our archaeologists are uploading the planet's location to our systems now.

label.zh: 或许对[baol_colony_1.GetName]开展深入调查会让我们获益良多。
label.en: Perhaps a closer investigation of [baol_colony_1.GetName] will prove fruitful.

texts.zh: 我们的研究人员发现了一些七百万年前的数据晶体，晶体内按年代顺序记录了一族被称作古茹努尔的太空战士的事迹，以及名为巴奥有机体的外星生命，其行星被古茹努尔所入侵。
texts.en: Our researchers have uncovered seven million year old datacrystals, chronicling the existence of a space-faring warrior race known as the Grunur, and the Baol Organism, an alien lifeform whose planets the Grunur invaded.

texts.zh: 我们找到了一长串前巴奥殖民地推断位置的坐标，应该着手深入调查。
texts.en: We have found a list of coordinates representing the supposed location of a former Baol colony. We should investigate further.

title.zh: 前巴奥殖民地：不毛之地

texts.zh:
尽管在[first_grunur_site.GetName]发现的古代古茹努尔数据晶体宣称此处存在丰富的资源，[baol_colony_1.GetName]只是一颗干旱、荒凉的星球，甚至没有大气层。

幸运的是，地质扫描表明在行星深处的沉积层中存在几乎取之不尽的化石状生物遗体！遗体中最有可能是巴奥的是一种植物类物种，因为只有该物种具备开智生物所需要的神经结构。

一次定向发掘应当可以揭示更多信息。
texts.en:
Despite the promise of riches suggested in the ancient Grunur datacrystals recovered from [first_grunur_site.GetName], [baol_colony_1.GetName] is a dry, barren world, void of atmosphere.

Fortunately, geological scans have revealed a near-endless trove of fossilized remains deep in the planet's sedimentary record! Among them is a plantoid species most likely to have been the Baol, as it is the only one identified in possession of the neurological structures required for sapience.

A targeted excavation should uncover more information.

texts.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]沉积层的深处，我们发现了一处含有许多植物类物种化石的极有价值的宝库，该物种具有的神经结构足以支撑智能的存在。

如果这些早已死去的生物的确是巴奥，研究他们的尸体可能会我们提供更多线索，以便弄清他们那一度草木葱茏的行星是如何变成了一个没有空气和生命的星球。
texts.en:
Deep in the geological record of [From.Planet.GetName], a trove of promising fossils belonging to a plantoid species possessing the neurological structures necessary for sapience have been uncovered.

If these long-dead creatures were indeed the Baol, studying their remains may yield insights into what transformed their once-lush planet into an airless, barren world.

sections.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]沉积层的深处，我们发现了一处含有许多植物类物种化石的极有价值的宝库，该物种具有的神经结构足以支撑智能的存在。

如果这些早已死去的生物的确是巴奥，研究他们的尸体可能会我们提供更多线索，以便弄清他们那一度草木葱茏的行星是如何变成了一个没有空气和生命的星球。
sections.en:
Deep in the geological record of [From.Planet.GetName], a trove of promising fossils belonging to a plantoid species possessing the neurological structures necessary for sapience have been uncovered.

If these long-dead creatures were indeed the Baol, studying their remains may yield insights into what transformed their once-lush planet into an airless, barren world.

texts.zh:
地质编录中显示的灰烬厚层和引人注目的大规模灭绝事件与先前从古茹努尔数据晶体中提取到的材料相吻合，表明是古茹努尔在大约七百万年前使用胶凝燃烧弹轰炸了[From.Planet.GetName]。

在行星地表肆虐的森林大火扰乱了当地的生态系统，由于缺少能进行光合作用的植物，行星的大气层在接下来六万年间被逐渐消耗殆尽。
texts.en:
Thick layers of ash and a notable mass-extinction event in the geological record coincide with material previously extracted from Grunur datacrystals, suggesting the Grunur firebombed [From.Planet.GetName] with a gelling incendiary roughly seven million years ago.

Widespread deforestation of the planet's surface disrupted local ecosystems, and the lack of oxygen-fixing vegetation gradually depleted the planet's atmosphere over the next sixty-thousand years.

texts.zh:
我们找到了数具保存完好的巴奥化石，其揭示出这一早已消失的物种具有蜂巢思维：数十亿植物体单位同心协力一体合作，如同一棵树上的枝、叶和根。树木年轮学分析表明个体巴奥的寿命可达数百年。

[From.Planet.GetName]上缺少残留的建筑物似乎是由巴奥对其高度发达的有机科技的依赖造成的。时光流逝让他们的舰船、建筑和湿体电脑消失殆尽。
texts.en:
Several exemplary Baol fossils have been recovered, revealing the long-lost species to have been a Hive Mind: billions of plantoid units working together as a whole, like the leaves and roots and branches of a tree. Dendrochronology suggests individual Baol specimens had lifespans in the hundreds of years.

The lack of structural ruins on [From.Planet.GetName] appears to be the result of the Baol's reliance on remarkable organic technology, from ships and buildings to wetware biocomputers, and the ravages of time.

texts.zh: 我们从一块破碎的古茹努尔数据晶体中提取到了另一个前巴奥殖民地的坐标！也许这颗行星上会有巴奥古老的敌人们所追寻的财富。
texts.en: Coordinates describing the location of another former Baol colony have been extracted from a shattered Grunur datacrystal! Perhaps this planet will boast some of the riches sought after by the Baol's ancient enemies.

title.zh: 前巴奥殖民地调查 II

texts.zh: 我们从古代古茹努尔数据晶体中提取到了另一个前巴奥殖民地的坐标，应该对该遗址进行深入调查。
texts.en: The coordinates of another former Baol colony have been extracted from an ancient Grunur datacrystal. We should investigate the site further.

title.zh: 前巴奥殖民地：破碎行星

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]的船员最初确信他们在进行三角定位以推算[Root.GetStarName]恒星系中的巴奥殖民地的理论位置时出了差错，因为在原本该有足以支持生命存在的行星的位置上除了若干小行星之外什么都没有。

但是，对这些小行星成分更进一步的研究表明它们事实上是前巴奥殖民地的残骸！大约是在七百万年前，曾经草木葱茏的行星被未知撞击炸成了数千块碎片。可以推断古茹努尔在这颗行星的悲惨结局中起到了某种作用。

一颗最有发掘价值的小行星已被选定为接下来研究的对象，在其上保留有消失行星上大量生物的化石化残骸。
texts.en:
The crew of the [Root.GetName] were initially certain they had made a triangulation mistake when deducing the coordinates of the supposed Baol colony in the [Root.GetStarName] system, having found nothing but asteroids where they expected a life-bearing planet.

However, closer study of the asteroids' composition has revealed that they are in fact what remains of the former Baol colony! The once-lush planet was blown into several thousand rocky pieces by some unknown collision, occurring roughly seven million years ago. Deduction suggests the Grunur played some role in the planet's dark fate.

One particularly promising asteroid has been selected for further study, as it appears to possess a large number of fossilized lifeforms from the lost planet.

label.zh: 真可惜。也许我们会从中学到些什么。
label.en: A pity. Perhaps we will learn more.

texts.zh: 虽然只是前巴奥殖民地留下的可悲残片，这一小行星仍有丰富的化石贮藏亟待发掘。我们的考古学家希望能对神秘的巴奥的历史和古茹努尔在此行星黑暗命运中扮演的可疑角色上有更多的发现。
texts.en: The tragic remains of a former Baol colony, this asteroid nevertheless contains a rich trove of fossils begging for excavation. Our archaeologists hope to discover more about the history of the mysterious Baol, and the Grunur's suspected role in the planet's dark fate.

sections.zh: 虽然只是前巴奥殖民地留下的可悲残片，这一小行星仍有丰富的化石贮藏亟待发掘。我们的考古学家希望能对神秘的巴奥的历史和古茹努尔在此行星黑暗命运中扮演的可疑角色上有更多的发现。
sections.en: The tragic remains of a former Baol colony, this asteroid nevertheless contains a rich trove of fossils begging for excavation. Our archaeologists hope to discover more about the history of the mysterious Baol, and the Grunur's suspected role in the planet's dark fate.

texts.zh:
我们设法从一块保存状况良好的巴奥生物计算机化石中提取出了一些数据片段！这一千万年前的古老遗物看起来存贮着教育学相关的信息，供该物种的未成年个体使用。由于尚未准备好与蜂巢思维进行完整的神经链接，幼年巴奥，或者说幼树，会被以更为精心设计的方式教授育苗技术、园艺学与营养学。

这些发现表明巴奥社会十分重视陆地景观美化和生态环境管理，其自身的生存也高度依赖这些技术。
texts.en:
We have managed to extract some data fragments from a particularly well-preserved Baol biocomputer fossil! This ten million year old relic appears to contain pedagogical information, intended for immature members of the species. Not yet ready to receive the full range of the Hive Mind's neural connection, young Baol, or saplings, were introduced to growth techniques, horticulture, and nutrition in a more curated experience.

These findings suggest Baol society prized terrestrial landscaping and ecosystem management, and were also highly dependent on it for their survival.

texts.zh:
发现另一台巴奥生物计算机的残片让我们对这一植物类蜂巢思维物种的历史有了更深入的了解。

巴奥看起来是纯粹的植物生命体，发源于位置未知的单一行星。史前巴奥全都是其亲代植物的克隆体，在其母星上缓慢而平和地生长了数百万年，并逐步发展出了承载蜂巢意识的能力。
texts.en:
The discovery of another ancient Baol biocomputer remnant has yielded further insight into this plantoid Hive Mind's history.

The Baol appear to have originated from a single planet, its location unknown, as mere plant life. Prehistoric Baol were all clones of their parent plants, and gradually developed the capacity for Hive consciousness over millions of years of slow, peaceful growth on their home planet.

texts.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上找到了一块古茹努尔数据晶体，大约是在七百万年前遗留在此。这块数据晶体存储了部分尚可读取的军事记录，其内容与入侵这颗行星有关。

显然，古茹努尔预料到会有某种形式的武装抵抗，移动极为缓慢的巴奥并没有给他们留下深刻的印象。记录中以高度贬损的语气描述了规避巴奥迟钝的火力回击有多么轻松。
texts.en:
A Grunur datacrystal has been recovered on [From.Planet.GetName], dating to some seven million years ago. The datacrystal contains partially readable military records, pertaining to the planet's invasion.

Apparently, the Grunur were expecting some measure of armed resistance, and were not impressed by the incredibly slow-moving Baol. The record describes the ease with which the Baol's delayed responses were circumvented, in a highly derogatory fashion.

texts.zh:
另一块古茹努尔数据晶体被发掘出土了，其内详细记述了一系列军事命令——包括另一处前巴奥殖民地的坐标。

我们的考古学家十分渴望弄清这两个相互敌对的国家的历史，并正在将数据上传。
texts.en:
Another Grunur datacrystal has been unearthed, detailing a series of military orders -- including the coordinates of another former Baol colony.

Our archaeologists, eager to further unravel the history of these two foes, are uploading the data now.

label.zh: 第三次会有好运气了吧……？

title.zh: 前巴奥殖民地调查 III

texts.zh: 我们从古代古茹努尔数据晶体中提取到了另一个前巴奥殖民地的坐标，应该对该遗址进行深入调查。
texts.en: The coordinates of another former Baol colony have been extracted from an ancient Grunur datacrystal. We should investigate the site further.

title.zh: 前巴奥殖民地：寂静无声

texts.zh:
我们的研究人员兴奋地发现第三个巴奥殖民地的位置与一颗仍拥有大气层和生命体的行星相吻合！

尽管[From.From.GetName]看起来并非特别草木葱茏或资源丰富，我们的科学家们还是急切地想要开展一次定向发掘，以寻找巴奥或古茹努尔留下的任何残余物。
texts.en:
Our researchers were excited to discover the location of the third Baol colony corresponds to a planet still possessing an atmosphere and life!

While [From.From.GetName] does not seem particularly lush or remarkably resource-laden, our scientists are eager to begin a targeted excavation to search for any remnants of the Baol, or the Grunur.

texts.zh: 这一前巴奥殖民地上仍然拥有大气层和低等生命，我们已在此建立了一个发掘点，以期能对这一文明最终的历史有更多的了解。
texts.en: Still in possession of an atmosphere and lower forms of life, a dig site has been established on this former Baol colony, in the hopes of shedding more light on the ultimate history of the civilization.

sections.zh: 这一前巴奥殖民地上仍然拥有大气层和低等生命，我们已在此建立了一个发掘点，以期能对这一文明最终的历史有更多的了解。
sections.en: Still in possession of an atmosphere and lower forms of life, a dig site has been established on this former Baol colony, in the hopes of shedding more light on the ultimate history of the civilization.

texts.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]的发掘工作中，我们找到了大量与巴奥明确相关的化石。不过，令人好奇的是，这些样本用于亚空间假突触通讯——一种蜂巢思维的专有天赋，可以在遥远的距离上进行神经通讯——的神经器官似乎已经退化。

尽管假定古茹努尔入侵与此无关是不负责任的，造成这种摇摆演化的明确原因仍然未知。相当有必要进行进一步的调查。
texts.en:
Excavation at [From.Planet.GetName] has revealed a number of fossils clearly related to the Baol -- but, curiously, these specimens appear to have diminished neurological organs required for subspace ephapse communication -- that is to say, the ability to communicate neurologically over great distances, a faculty unique to Hive Minds.

What definitive causes may have precipitated this evolutionary swing are unknown, though it would be remiss to assume to the Grunur invasion was unrelated. Further investigation is warranted.

texts.zh:
更新的巴奥化石从地质记录中被挖掘出来了，这些标本已不再具有退化的蜂巢神经系统。反之，亚空间假突触交流所需的结构完全消失了！

样本的碳年代测定已经证实，在古茹努尔入侵后的几百年里，巴奥开始放弃作为蜂巢思维彼此连接的能力。

不幸的是，在这个遗迹中似乎无法取得更多相关数据了。
texts.en:
Younger Baol fossil specimens have been uncovered from the geological record, though these no longer have diminished Hive neurologies. Instead, the structures required for subspace ephapse communication are entirely missing!

Carbon-dating of the specimens has confirmed that some hundreds of years following the Grunur invasion, the Baol began to devolve their ability to connect to one another as a Hive Mind.

Unfortunately, it seems no further relevant data can be extracted from this site.

texts.zh:
我们的科学家正在接收一个包含古茹努尔数字签名的求救信号！它似乎来源于一个迄今未被我们发现的恒星系，在[last_baol_neighbor.GetName]附近。

它可能包含着什么样的古老信息？

我们的科学家想要调查信号的来源地。
texts.en:
Our scientists are picking up a distress signal bearing Grunur datalogical signatures! It appears to originate from a system previously unknown to us, near [last_baol_neighbor.GetName].

What kind of ancient message could it possibly contain?

Our scientists would like to investigate the signal's point of origin.

tooltips.zh: 发起特殊项目：古茹努尔求救信号
tooltips.en: Issues Special Project: Grunur Distress Signal

texts.zh: 我们的传感器收到了似乎包含古茹努尔数字签名的求救信号。在这一迄今未被发现的恒星系里，这个早已消失的物种还有可能留下些什么呢？
texts.en: Our sensors have picked up what appears to be a distress signal bearing Grunur datalogical signatures. What could possibly remain of this long lost species, in this hitherto-undiscovered star system?

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员跟踪到了古茹努尔求救信号源并发现了摇摇欲坠的古茹努尔研究设施，其处于一个废弃已久的行星的轨道。该设施即将失去能源供应，其上工作了数百万年的大型太阳能电池板网络和逐渐腐朽的自动维修系统很快就要达到使用寿命的极限了。

我们对设施进行了扫描并震惊地发现这里有一个生命体存在。船员派出了现场调查队伍，他们已经准备好进行报告。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew have traced the Grunur distress signal to its source, uncovering a crumbling Grunur research facility, hanging in orbit of an otherwise long-abandoned planet. The facility is reaching critical energy failure, having survived for millions of years on an extensive network of solar panels and decaying auto-repair systems, all of which are now approaching terminal status.

Shockingly enough, scans of the facility are revealing the presence of a single lifeform. The crew have dispatched an away team, and are ready to report.

texts.zh:
在残破的古茹努尔旧研究设施残骸深处，在长久废弃的电脑面板和破损的研究设备之间，我们的船员有了难以置信的发现。

靠着营养管和损坏严重的生命支持系统的维持，该物种的孑遗个体静静地躺在这里：最后的巴奥，奇迹般地依旧存活，被一排从破损的罐子中流淌出的已然高度腐烂的其他个体的尸体所环绕。

由于我们的考古学家之前对该物种有过大量的研究，我们得以和这一物种最后的个体进行交流。
texts.en:
Deep in the dilapidated ruins of the timeworn Grunur research facility, among the long-defunct computer panels and deteriorated research equipment, our ship's crew has made an incredible find.

Pincushioned by nutrient tubes and critically failing life support systems, lies one single organism: the last Baol, miraculously still alive, surrounded by the sludgy remains of other specimens in a row of cracked and leaking vats.

Owing to our extensive previous archaeological studies on the species, we should be able to attempt communications with this last specimen.

label.zh: 一个有机体？启动灭绝协议……

texts.zh:
“一个访客？怎么可能？”

巴奥在他的罐子里瑟瑟发抖。

“尽管你的到来带来了警报声，但是你并不是把我们置于此地的人。你最终能为我们带来安宁吗？”
texts.en:
"A visitor? Can it be?"

The Baol shudders in its vat.

"But you are not the ones who put us here, though you come as the alarms sound. Have you come to give us peace, at last?"

label.zh: 可能吧。但是首先，我们有几个问题。
label.en: Perhaps. But first, we have a few questions.

label.zh: 我们会通过任何可能的方式来帮助你们。
label.en: We will help you any way we can.

label.zh: 异种，你们要回答我们的问题。而不是反过来。
label.en: You will answer to us, xeno. Not the reverse.

texts.zh: 巴奥沉默了数分钟。“那么问吧。我们已经等了数百万年。我们还能够再忍受一会儿。”
texts.en: The Baol is silent for several minutes. "Then ask. We have waited millennia. We can endure a moment more."

responses.zh:
过了相当长一段时间，巴奥有了回应。

“我们自己？我们……我。是的。还能说什么呢？我们在柔软的土地上沐浴着星辰的光芒，迎风舒展着枝叶，如同迎着太阳的风帆。我们记得灼热的炎夏中滴落的每一粒水滴，也记得颤栗的寒冬中覆落的每一片霜雪。当群星在头顶不断旋转时，我们会迎着着微风摇摆着身躯。

后来，我们被连根拔起，被焚为灰烬，被大卸八块。我们被监禁在这里，互相看着彼此，腐烂在玻璃的监狱里。”
responses.en:
Long minutes pass before the Baol responds.

"Ourself? Our...self. Yes. What is there to tell? We sat beneath the stars on soft earth, unfurled our leaves like sails to the sun overhead. We remember every drop of water that quenched them in the parched summers. Every shivering hoar that blanketed them in winters. We bent in the wind as the stars wheeled overhead.

We were uprooted. We were burned. We were sliced. We were left here. We watched our others rot in their glass prisons.

responses.zh:
再一次，巴奥在回答前陷入了长时间的沉默。“当焚烧者到来的时候，我们意识到危险之前整个殖民地就陷入了沉寂。如同半身不遂一般，各处突触被迅速切断，从根本上断开连接。然后我们失去了下一个，下一个，再下一个。一个又一个，他们的声音离开了合唱。我们失去了许多个体。他们的沉默使剩下的我们陷入无尽的沮丧。

你能理解吗，来访者？我们承受了无上的痛苦。焚烧者能迅速移动，就像你们一样，在我们能够撤离之前他们就使我们都陷于了火海中，尽数化为灰烬。整个空气中充斥着灰色的痛苦，那是我们逝去同伴的骨灰。”
responses.en:
Again, the Baol is long silent before managing a reply. "When the burners came, entire colonies were silenced before the danger was known to us. Like a limb gone limp, nerves cut suddenly and totally at the base. And then we lost the next, and the next, and the next. One by one, their voices left the chorus. We lost our others. Their silence deafened us who remained.

Can you understand, visitor? We could not bear to hear more agony. The burners were swift, like you, swifter, and before we could withdraw, they had set us all aflame. All burnt to ash, and the air filled with that gray agony: the dust of our lost."

label.en: Would you like to join us?

texts.zh: 巴奥在长时间的沉默后才做出了最终的回应。“谢谢你。我们已经忘记了善意的声音。”
texts.en: The Baol is silent for long moments before finally replying. "Thank you. We had forgotten the sound of kindness."

texts.zh:
巴奥全身一阵颤抖，让人感觉它似乎正在狂笑。“不用了。我们已经在这种扭曲的状态下生活很久了。现在我们只求一死。不过首先……你可以告诉我们吗？我们被封闭在这里太久，除了这个房间什么也见不到，就这样看着污浊的空气一点一点将空间站腐蚀到只剩下金属骨架。

告诉我们。我们的族群……还存在吗？”
texts.en:
A sort of shiver runs through Baol. You have the distinct impression it is laughing. "No. We have lived too long in this wretched state. Now we long only for an end. Though first... Would you tell us? We have been sealed here for so long, blind to all but this room, watching the stale air slowly wear the station down to its metal bones.

Tell us. Does our kind... yet live?"

texts.zh:
“等等。”巴奥颤抖道。“在一切结束之前。我们的亲族，求求你们。我们被封闭在这里太久，除了这个房间什么也见不到，就这样看着污浊的空气一点一点将空间站腐蚀到只剩下金属骨架。

告诉我们。我们的族群……还存在吗？”
texts.en:
"Wait." The Baol trembles. "Before it all ends. Our kin. Please. We have been sealed here for so long, blind to all but this room, watching the stale air slowly wear the station down to its metal bones.

Tell us. Does our kind... yet live?"

label.zh: 某种意义上还存在。但他们已经不再是有智慧的物种了。
label.en: In a sense. Though they are no longer sapient.

label.zh: 我们没有时间浪费在这里。拔下插头！
label.en: We don't have time for this. Pull the plug!

texts.zh:
慢慢地，几乎不知不觉地，最后的巴奥的枝叶自行枯萎了，只剩下一点点。“或许……或许这才是最好的。”

将神秘液体泵入泵出这个生物体的机器开始嘶嘶作响。很明显这是这台机器的垂死挣扎，而巴奥在离开机器后也将死去。

“沉默，是的。最终它到来了。我们欢迎沉默，就像我们的弟兄很久之前做的那样。永别了，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。愿你的至亲在这个世界承受较少的痛苦。”
texts.en:
Slowly, almost imperceptibly, the leaves of the last Baol shrivel in on themselves, just a little more. "Perhaps... perhaps that is best."

The machine pumping mysterious fluids in and out of the creature's body begin to sputter and hiss. It is clearly on its last mechanical gasp, and the Baol will perish without it.

"Silence, yes. At last it approaches. We welcome it, as our brethren did so long ago. Farewell, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. May your kin endure less agony in this world."

label.zh: 你们的独特性将会永存。
label.en: Your uniqueness will not be lost.

texts.zh:
你的科学家们找到了将营养物质输入、代谢废物输出该生物体的管道并逐一将其拔出，加速机器的损坏过程，以便加快最后的巴奥的死亡。

当你工作时，巴奥似乎没有做出任何抵抗，除非它那萎缩肢体的轻微摆动是想要表示些什么。

最后，工作完成了，伴随着最后一次波及全身的震颤，该生物断了气。
texts.en:
Reaching for the tubes that ferry mysterious nutrients in and out of the creature's form, your scientists begin to jerk them loose, expediting the machinery's failure and thereby the last Baol's death.

The Baol seems to make no protest as you work, unless the slight tremor running through its withered limbs is meant to signify something.

Finally, the work is complete, and one final tremor runs through the creature before it expires.

label.zh: 你们的独特性将会永存。
label.en: Your uniqueness will not be lost.

texts.zh: 来自[From.GetName]的科学官已经定位了最后的巴奥样本！
texts.en: Scientists from the [From.GetName] have located the last Baol specimen!

title.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Baol

texts.zh: 我们的科学家将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求巴奥的知识并为我们所用。
texts.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the Baol to our own.

texts.zh:
通过研究巴奥的资料，我们对行星生命播种及环境改造过程都有了新的认识。

在仔细研究巴奥失去感知能力的变化过程后，我们也了解了诸多关于提升技术的知识，但我们已经掌握这项技术了。
texts.en:
Studying the Baol has given us new insights into the spread of plant life and improved our terraforming processes.

By carefully tracking the changes that the Baol underwent during their loss of sentience we also learned much about the uplifting process, but have already mastered that technology.

texts.zh:
在仔细研究巴奥失去感知能力的变化过程后，我们已经获得了足够的知识以逆转此过程。

我们也同样对行星生命播种及环境改造技术有了新的认识。
texts.en:
By carefully tracking the changes that the Baol underwent during their loss of sentience, we have gained much knowledge on how to reverse that process.

We have also gained new insights into the spread of plant life and improved our terraforming processes.
